description: This file defines external API function prototypes for the TFTP Client Object in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It includes function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the TFTP client, serving as an interface for external modules to interact with the TFTP client component.

methods.name: AnscCreateTftpClient
methods.description: Creates a new TFTP client object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscTftpcoCreate
methods.description: Internal function to create a TFTP client object instance.

methods.name: AnscTftpcoRemove
methods.description: Removes a TFTP client object instance.

methods.name: AnscTftpcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the TFTP client component.
